# pricing (as of this doc, changes a lot, ask sara for latest)

Three tiers right now:

- **Starter** — per-robot monthly fee only, no platform fee, capped at 10 robots. for pilots
  basically.
- **Growth** — per-robot fee (slightly lower than starter, volume discount kicks in) + a flat
  monthly platform fee for the routing/fleet software. this is where most real customers land.
- **Scale** — custom pricing, for anyone running 30+ robots across multiple sites (this is Finch's
  bucket, though their exact contract predates these tier names so it's technically custom-custom).

Discounts: standard policy is no discount for annual commit under 25 robots, up to 10% for
multi-year commits above that, anything bigger than 10% needs Rohan's sign-off (see the Finch
renewal doc for an example of that happening).
